exact_statement: The pointwise same-K activation-witness transport assertion is false: let f be +1 except at one point of the uniform three-cube, and F=1+A_8(f^tensor16-1) on 56 independent uniform bits. At lambda=0,K=5/2 every seed coordinate and every one of the 48 data coordinates of F has B_i/Inf_i>5/2, while every one of the eight controls has B_i/Inf_i<5/2. The maximum influence of F is 4251920575/1099511627776<1/256. Thus a K-witness in this activated image need not yield a K-witness in its seed. This refutes pointwise witness transport only, not the universally quantified localized endpoint or FEI.
hypotheses: Point activation of the unbalanced tensor core; no auxiliary balancing literal
